is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Kisumu strain) in Benin.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions previous molecular genotyping of the L1014F allele in the study population (page 3, 'Molecular genotyping and microarray studies have demonstrated a high frequency of the L1014F allele (>90%)'), but it does not report new genotype data or counts for these markers in the current study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any new genotype counts or frequencies for the current study; it only references previous studies for the resistance profile of the population.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Covè, Benin, using wild-caught mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial evaluating a new insecticide.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the CREC/LSHTM experimental hut station in Covè, Southern Benin.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial ran for 18 months between November 2019 and May 2021.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data for the study's outcomes (bioassays and hut trials) are presented in the main text tables and figures.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of VECTRON T500 (broflanilide) for indoor residual spraying against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in experimental huts in Benin. While it mentions previous molecular data (L1014F) for the population, it does not report any new genotype data.
